business_scope.primary_industry_name: Eco-Friendly Beechwood Turning of Non-Toxic Sensory Toddler Toys

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) — Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation (BC) Registry
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — Common Law (U.S.-style); Business Corporations Act modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law; Marshallese customary law reserved for land and traditional matters; unitary national jurisdiction with no sub-state corporate tax distinctions
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Government of the United States and the Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (1986, as amended 2003) — investment guarantees, MFN treatment, and commercial rights
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus, 2017) — trade and trade-related assistance
South Pacific Regional Trade and Economic Cooperation Agreement (SPARTECA) — non-reciprocal preferential trade access to Australia and New Zealand

No comprehensive income tax treaty (DTAA) with the United States or major E.U. economies in force; Non-Resident Domestic Corporations elect RMI tax-exempt status under the Income Tax Act via the annual USD 425 flat exemption fee

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended (RMI), Sections 41 (registered agent), 104 (registered office), 105 (corporate name), and 106 (name reservation); Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2000, as amended, imposing customer due diligence, beneficial ownership record-keeping, and suspicious activity reporting obligations; RMI Criminal Code 2003 (money-laundering offences); Pacific Island Financial Supervisory Commission Act 2014 (regional AML/CFT supervision via PIFSC); UBO records are maintained by licensed Registered Agents and are producible to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit, the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, and PIFSC upon lawful demand; APG/FATF mutual-evaluation follow-up reporting applies

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the biometric passport page of each director, shareholder, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority of the document-holder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address dated within 90 days (utility bill, bank statement, or government-issued registration record)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing utility company, bank, or municipal authority of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original professional bank reference letter (business profile, expected transaction volumes, and 12-month account standing)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account-holding bank of the beneficial owner or corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and current register extract for each corporate shareholder (issued within 30 days before filing)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-jurisdiction corporate registry (e.g., Companies House, ACRA, or a U.S. Secretary of State office)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized constitutional documents (Memorandum and Articles of Association / Certificate of Incorporation) of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-jurisdiction notary public and corporate registry

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, company secretaries, and authorized signatories against: (i) the UN Security Council Consolidated List; (ii) the OFAC SDN List — RMI transacts through U.S. correspondent clearing, is a Compact state, and Amazon Pay / Stripe contractually enforce OFAC compliance, so OFAC designations carry immediate practical effect; (iii) UK/EU consolidated financial sanctions as a prudent overlay; and (iv) RMI national designations. Full PEP identification (foreign, domestic, and international-organization) at onboarding, with source-of-wealth documentation and senior-management approval for any PEP relationship; adverse-media review and ongoing transaction monitoring for the low-risk-standard consumer-toys profile. Suspicious transaction reporting to the RMI FIU under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2000, as amended; registered-agent CDD files must be inspection-ready at all times.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (ORC), Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro — administered in coordination with the Association of Marshall Islands Registered Agents (AMIRA); name reservations and name-clearance checks are submitted exclusively by a licensed RMI Registered Agent; no direct public self-service portal exists
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate records are maintained in English (an official language of RMI alongside Marshallese). Corporate names must use the Latin (Roman) alphabet; CJK, Cyrillic, Arabic, or other non-Latin scripts require a certified transliteration into Latin characters filed with the name reservation. The name must include a corporate suffix (e.g., 'Corp.', 'Inc.', 'Ltd.') and must not be identical to, or confusingly similar to, any existing RMI company name, reserved name, or foreign qualified name on the ORC index.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Tokens implying government or sovereign connection: 'Government', 'Ministry', 'Embassy', 'Consulate', 'Federal', 'State', 'National', 'Municipal', 'Authority', 'Central Bank' — require ministerial consent or are absolutely prohibited

Regulated financial tokens requiring a sectoral license: 'Bank', 'Banking', 'Trust', 'Trustee', 'Insurance', 'Reinsurance', 'Assurance', 'Deposit', 'Securities', 'Investment Fund', 'Financial Services'
Legal-form confusion tokens: 'LLC', 'Limited Liability Partnership', 'Cooperative', 'Partnership', 'Foundation', 'Société Anonyme' where they misrepresent the actual Business Corporation form
Public, charitable, and educational tokens: 'University', 'College', 'Red Cross', 'Red Crescent', 'Olympic', 'United Nations', 'Rotary', 'International Monetary Fund'
Public-policy and misleading tokens: terms that are obscene, fraudulent, or falsely imply RMI government sponsorship or an international-designation endorsement
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection under Section 105 of the Business Corporations Act 1990 (identical or confusingly similar, misleading, or containing a prohibited token): (1) obtain the Registrar's written statement of rejection; (2) file an administrative reconsideration petition with the ORC within 14 calendar days — the Registrar shall respond within 30 calendar days; (3) in parallel, reserve a modified distinguishing name (adding a distinctive token, alphanumeric qualifier, or geographic descriptor) and re-file for speed of clearance; (4) if the Registrar maintains refusal of a legally compliant name, file a civil appeal in the RMI High Court within 30 calendar days of the final administrative decision; in practice, the parallel re-file route is preferred to minimize incorporation delay.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.sectoral_license_note: The metadata flag 'requires_statutory_license: true' is satisfied outside the RMI shell: the operating manufacturing entity must hold the production-country business license and the applicable toy-safety certifications (U.S. CPSIA/ASTM F963, E.U. EN 71/CE, ISO 8124) before Amazon Pay and Stripe onboarding; the RMI Non-Resident BC itself requires no RMI sectoral license for offshore toy manufacturing, trading, or licensing activity.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible and standard for a Non-Resident Domestic BC: the Business Corporations Act 1990 requires only a registered office and a licensed Registered Agent in Majuro; no physical business premises, employees, or tangible assets in RMI are required. The company must remain centrally managed and controlled outside RMI, derive no RMI-source income, and hold no RMI real property in order to preserve its Tax-Exempt Zone classification and its annual USD 425 flat-fee income-tax exemption. The use of a registered-agent address as the statutory seat is fully accepted by payment processors and banks, provided the true commercial substance (supply contracts, safety certifications, and manufacturing licenses) is documented in the registered agent's CDD file.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated 2–5% probability per rolling 12-month window for a standard non-resident BC. RMI authorities do not conduct unannounced inspections of foreign business premises of non-resident companies; ORC and PIFSC supervisory reviews are document-based and are performed at the licensed Registered Agent's premises in Majuro. The CDD and corporate-record file must therefore be inspection-ready at the agent's office at all times; the probability of an unannounced site visit rises above 50% only for the Registered Agent itself or for licensed financial institutions under the PIFSC supervisory cycle.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and name reservation filing fee (primary name, one reservation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (Business Corporations Act 1990 fee schedule)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Filing fee for Articles of Incorporation, Business Corporation (authorized capital up to USD 50,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff (Business Corporations Act 1990 filing schedule)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed Registered Agent and registered office services — year one (including RMI annual agent reporting compliance)
UBO due diligence, PEP/OFAC/UN sanctions screening, and KYC file compilation by Registered Agent
Notarization of passport, address, bank reference, and corporate-participant document bundle (4–5 documents)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Designated Competent Authority in country of origin (e.g., U.S. Secretary of State / U.S. Department of State)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, Republic of the Marshall Islands

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation structuring and legal due-diligence opinion (outside counsel, fixed fee)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External corporate counsel (RMI-licensed or allied U.S. law firm)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Banking and payment-rail onboarding support for Amazon Pay and Stripe (KYC packet preparation, processor questionnaires, compliance correspondence)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act (BCA), Title 27 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, as amended; particularly Sections 24 (Articles of Incorporation), 27 (Corporate Name), 45-46 (Registered Agent and Office), 74-76 (Organization and Bylaws), and 79 (Directors' and Officers' authority).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro Atoll.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation filed with the Registrar of Corporations together with the Registered Agent's Consent to Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the Corporation may issue no-par shares for nominal consideration. Paid-up capital need not be escrowed or deposited with any bank in the Marshall Islands; however, the Corporation must maintain a licensed registered agent and a resident agent in Majuro for service of process and annual franchise tax reporting.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the Corporation accept the subscription of the initial shareholder for 5,000 no-par value common shares at a total consideration of US$1,000, which shall be fully paid and non-assessable; that the registered office be established at the Registered Agent's office in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands; that the Bylaws submitted to this meeting be adopted as the Bylaws of the Corporation; that the individuals named in the minutes be appointed President, Secretary, and Treasurer; and that management be authorized to open corporate bank and payment gateway accounts (including Amazon Pay and Stripe) and to execute all documents necessary for formation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (online name reservation system and counters at Majuro).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two or three proposed corporate names in the required format (must include 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or an approved abbreviation). Verify that the chosen name is not confusingly similar to any registered Marshall Islands or foreign entity reserved in the registry. Pay the name reservation fee and obtain the reservation certificate before proceeding to Articles of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of name reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected for similarity, submit an alternative name or obtain a written consent/letter of no-objection from the conflicting entity and re-file within 15 calendar days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands notary public and the designated registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in English specifying: corporate name, purpose clause covering manufacture and distribution of toys and educational products, authorized share structure, registered office in Majuro, registered agent name and address, and names of initial directors. Have the incorporator sign before a notary and obtain the registered agent's signed consent. Verify that the purpose clause covers ISIC 3240 (manufacture of games and toys) to avoid registry queries.
required_dossiers: Registered agent due diligence forms (Know Your Client)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Registrar queries the purpose clause, submit a certified short-form amendment or a supplemental memorandum clarifying that toy manufacturing is included within the authorized purposes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles and Payment of State Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the notarized Articles of Incorporation, registered agent consent, and name reservation certificate with the Registrar of Corporations. Pay the official filing fee of US$250 plus registration fees and the first annual franchise tax prepayment required for a non-resident domestic corporation. Upon successful review, the Registrar will issue the Certificate of Incorporation and assign the entity registration number.
required_dossiers: Evidence of payment of filing fee and franchise tax
Filed-in-blank resignation letter of incorporator (common practice)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is rejected for substantive defect, correct the flagged items within 15 business days by resubmitting amended Articles; expedited review is available upon payment of a supplemental fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting and First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Corporation (private corporate action; minutes maintained in registered office or principal administrative records).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene a first meeting (in person or by unanimous written consent) of the sole or initial directors. Adopt the Bylaws, elect the initial officers (President, Secretary, Treasurer), ratify the subscription and issuance of common shares, confirm the registered office and agent, approve the banking resolution, and authorize officers to open payment gateway accounts (Amazon Pay, Stripe). Execute the First Board Resolution and file a certificate (if required) with the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Minutes or written consents of the organizational meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where an officer's appointment is invalidated by resignation or conflict, cure by a written resolution of the remaining directors reappointing a qualified officer and retroactively ratifying acts performed in good faith.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Non-Resident Status Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Tax and Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a Marshall Islands Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and register the Corporation's non-resident status. Submit the Certificate of Incorporation, First Board Resolution, and a declaration that the Corporation will derive no income from sources within the Marshall Islands. Obtain the official non-resident tax exemption certificate confirming that the entity is not subject to RMI income tax on foreign-source income and is not required to file gross revenue tax returns for offshore operations.
required_dossiers: Declaration of non-resident status and foreign-source income
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Ministry of Finance requires additional evidence of non-resident status, file supplemental affidavits and the organizational meeting minutes to demonstrate absence of local management and control within the Marshall Islands.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business License Office, Tax and Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance; and the Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI EPA).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a Business License application for light manufacturing of wooden toys and educational products if any physical production, warehousing, or administrative activity will occur within the territory of the Marshall Islands. Simultaneously file the RMI EPA environmental registration for a small-scale woodworking facility. If all operations will be conducted through third-party toll manufacturers overseas and the entity is a pure non-resident holding/branding company, certify that no on-island operations occur, and request a letter of exemption from the Business License Office. Confirm compliance with the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation annual flat fee regime.
required_dossiers: Facility lease or title, if on-island manufacturing is present
Product specification sheet confirming non-toxic finishes (EN 71-3 / ASTM F963)
Fire safety clearance and structural inspection report (if local premises exist)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Business License is withheld pending environmental inspection, secure a provisional license by posting a compliance bond and delivering a corrective action plan; for pure non-resident entities, appeal to the Registrar/Secretary for a written exemption determination.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business License Office, Tax and Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; coordinated with the Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI EPA) for industrial premises.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License for Manufacturing (Wooden Toys and Educational Play Products) / Foreign Investment Business License (if on-island physical operations are undertaken by non-citizen shareholders); alternatively, a written exemption for a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation conducting no domestic activity.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: EIA Registration (Category 2 – Small-Scale Light Manufacturing): low-impact wood turning, sanding, and non-toxic water-based finishing without chemical treatment, electroplating, or boiler combustion. Full Environmental Impact Assessment (Category 1 EIA Report) is not required where process wastewater is not generated and VOC emissions remain below regulatory thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero process wastewater discharge to Majuro Lagoon or groundwater; any treated sanitary discharge must comply with RMI EPA water quality criteria (pH 6.5-8.5, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L). Air emissions: total VOCs not to exceed 10 tons per year from finishes; particulate matter from sanding controlled to ≤ 0.1 gr/dscf via dust extraction; sawdust and offcuts must be segregated and transported in covered containers to an approved landfill. All paints and finishes must comply with ASTM F963 / EN 71-3 heavy-metal migration limits (lead ≤ 90 ppm, antimony ≤ 60 ppm, mercury ≤ 60 ppm) and be certified non-phthalate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Majuro Fire Department confirming the production and storage areas are equipped with approved extinguishers, egress, and combustible-dust controls; structural and electrical load inspection and certification by the Building Inspection Office of the Ministry of Public Works; occupational clearance under the RMI Labor Safety and Health Regulations requiring local exhaust ventilation for wood dust, hearing protection around turning machinery, machine guarding, and a workplace injury response protocol. If the entity operates purely off-island via contract manufacturers, these physical clearances are not required in the Marshall Islands; instead, the Corporation must retain certificates of conformity from each third-party factory.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands Ministry of Finance – Taxation Division; taxpayer portal and registration via the Marshall Islands Business Registry (https://www.businessregistrymarshallislands.com) and the Marco Island office, with TIN issuance administered by the Ministry of Finance in coordination with the Registrar of Corporations
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity intending to engage in any taxable business activity in the Marshall Islands must first incorporate or register a foreign entity with the Registrar of Corporations under the Business Corporations Act or the Foreign Investment Business Act, obtain a Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) from the Foreign Investment Board, then file a Taxpayer Registration Application with the Ministry of Finance – Taxation Division; the Ministry will issue a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) or VAT ID as applicable; representative branch operations require a registered local address and resident agent; non-resident corporations with no domestic-source activity are treated as offshore entities and may obtain a TIN for administrative purposes or rely on the certification of exempt status under the Non-Living and Non-Domestic Corporations regime
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The Marshall Islands does not operate a check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election in the U.S. tax sense; entities may elect non-resident exempt status under section 145 of the Business Corporations Act to be relieved of all income tax and withholding obligations; hybrid entities formed under the Limited Liability Company Act may elect to be taxed as a partnership or corporation solely for foreign tax characterisation, but such election has no effect on Marshall Islands domestic taxation; no statutory hybrid mismatch election exists, and the Tax Exemption for Offshore Entities under the Income Tax Act allows a full domestic income tax exemption while the entity may retain a foreign tax classification for home-jurisdiction reporting; an entity may also elect the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation tax classification under the former Revenue Act where the Internal Revenue Code provisions have been adopted by reference, but the election is dormant and confers no practical domestic tax liability

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No Marshall Islands VAT or general sales tax is in force; the territory applies no statutory economic-turnover threshold because no indirect tax system is currently operational; under the Revenue and Taxation Act, no VAT registration threshold is prescribed; a non-resident corporation with no Marshall Islands source sales is not registerable and receives an exempt status certification; if a future VAT (General Excise or Business License Tax) is enacted, the threshold would follow the Revitalized Business and Non-Domestic Corporation revenue rules but none is currently codified
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or API-based real-time fiscal reporting mandate exists under Marshall Islands law; the Ministry of Finance does not operate a continuous transaction control (CTC) system; businesses are not required to obtain any pre-approval for invoices; electronic invoices may be issued voluntarily, but no government portal exists for invoice clearance; the only regime-adjacent requirement is the annual Business License Renewal filing and, where the entity holds a FIBL, the submission of economic data to the Foreign Investment Board

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Because the Marshall Islands levies no VAT or GST, there is no statutory zero-rating provision to claim; a qualifying exporter of goods, including ISIC 3240 Montessori beechwood toy blocks, is equally free from Marshall Islands indirect tax because no indirect tax attaches at the point of export; governmental fees (export permit, port charges) may apply, but no VAT zero-rating certificate is required; goods exported from Marshall Islands customs territory are outside the charge of any consumption tax; the exporter may confirm its exempt status through the Tax Exemption Certification issued by the Ministry of Finance under the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation regime
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration filed with the Marshall Islands Customs Service (under the Customs Act 1990, as amended)
Bill of Lading issued by the ocean carrier or House Bill of Lading from a licensed Marshall Islands freight forwarder
Inward Remittance Certificate or foreign exchange record evidencing export proceeds repatriation to a commercial bank if generated within the Marshall Islands banking system
Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) held by the exporting entity, where required under the Foreign Investment Business Act
Title or export manifest for wooden toy blocks (ISIC 3240) showing HS classification 9503.00, weight, cubic measurement, and port of loading
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Marshall Islands law imposes no VAT zero-rating clawback because no VAT refund mechanism exists; however, an exporter that falsely claims non-resident exempt status while carrying on domestic-source activity may face loss of exempt status, reassessment of the full 3% corporate income tax or 2% gross revenue tax with interest, plus penalties up to 25% of the underpaid tax under the Income Tax Act; making a false declaration to the Customs Service constitutes a customs offence punishable by forfeiture of goods and fines up to USD 5,000 per act, and any fraudulent inducement of a tax exemption may lead to revocation of the FIBL and blacklisting from future export licenses; directors and officers may be subject to USD 10,000 civil penalties and suspension of the corporation's good standing; the Attorney General may seek retrospective clawback of any indirect tax incentives improperly obtained for a period of five years

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commission of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, Ministry of Finance (no domestic central bank exists; monetary policy is effectively determined by the U.S. Federal Reserve because the U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Marshall Islands has no domestic currency and therefore imposes no exchange-control distinction between current-account and capital-account transactions. The U.S. dollar circulates freely, and non-resident Business Corporations may remit dividends, management fees, or liquidation proceeds without FX licensing or central-bank approval. The only practical hurdle is bank-level due diligence: a non-resident entity must evidence beneficial ownership, source of funds, and commercial substance before a payout, but profit repatriation is unrestricted as a matter of statute and BOP treatment.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender regime, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation timeline apply to RMI exporters. Because export sales are denominated and settled in USD, no conversion event exists. Under the RMI Banking Act and the Beneficial Ownership Act, banks must retain trade documents and transaction records for at least five years, but no obligation exists to force export receivables into a local account or to swap them into local currency.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (USD Demand Deposit)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Medium-Low for a non-resident RMI Business Corporation. Fully digital EMIs that accept RMI-incorporated clients (e.g., Wise Business, Mercury, Stripe Treasury) will require evidence of an active e-commerce marketplace, minimum projected monthly settlement volumes, and a substantive-operations questionnaire. Statutory constraints: RMI-licensed banks treat EMI settlement flows as correspondent exposure, and many EMIs apply country-policy exclusions or enhanced-UAB searches to Annex-II and no-substance jurisdictions. An EMI can serve as the Amazon/Stripe payout collection rail but cannot be the sole bank account when the treasury plan requires an escrow facility, supplier LC, or domestic clearing relationship.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The RMI Banking Act and Banking Commission AML/CFT Guidance do not prescribe a face-to-face interview as a statutory condition, but they require banks to conduct enhanced due diligence on non-resident directors and UBOs. In practice, every tier-1 RMI bank mandates an in-branch interview for at least one director or an authorized signatory holding a notarized power of attorney before account activation. Remote opening is available only under bank-specific digital onboarding policies, typically requiring video verification plus an RMI-licensed introducer or registered-agent attestation, and is subject to an additional correspondent-bank second review when the account sends or receives USD via U.S. banks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Non-resident Business Corporation with no local substance and no public UBO register
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Articles of Incorporation; Certificate of Good Standing from the RMI Registrar; registered-agent confirmation; current Register of Directors and registered address; signed UBO register attestation; operational substance memo covering the Amazon Seller account, third-party warehouse, and supplier contracts; two years of pro-forma financials or audited statements; local phone line and registered office evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Unexplained initial capital injection or rapid movement of shareholder funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SWIFT MT103 wire confirmation from the shareholder's source bank; source-of-wealth declaration; bank reference letter from the shareholder's primary banker; board resolution approving the equity subscription; updated Register of Shareholders; escrow agreement for inbound funds; maintenance of a US$1,000 minimum share-capital deposit (non-statutory but commonly imposed by bank policy).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Third-party settlement flows routed from Amazon Pay and Stripe without clear ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amazon Seller Central account-verification page; Stripe account-ownership confirmation linking the RMI entity; payment-facilitator terms and processing agreement; order-level reconciliation report covering monthly gross settlements; refund and chargeback policy with customer-contact protocol; underlying trade documents for toy sales, including commercial invoices, bills of lading, and customs declarations; confirmation that marketplace payout currency is USD.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Sector-related product-safety licensing and alleged consumer-goods risk for children's toys
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: CPSC and ASTM F963-17 certificate for the wooden blocks; EN 71 test report evidencing non-toxic paints and finishes; CPSIA compliance certificate; product-liability insurance certificate naming Amazon.com Services LLC as additional insured; ISO 9001 quality manual (optional but favorable); batch-level safety documentation and a written recall-response protocol; supply-chain declaration confirming FSC-certified beechwood sourcing.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: the shareholder wires USD equity via SWIFT MT103 using purpose code 'EQUI' (or BOP direct-investment code 6.17) with the OBI field stating 'Capital Contribution - MH__MH__MH_BC__ISIC_3240_11_BABY_MONTESSORI_WOODEN_BLOCKS'. The receiving RMI bank must be furnished with the board resolution, updated Register of Shareholders, source-of-wealth form, and the signed escrow/account-opening agreement before crediting the Capital Escrow Account. The funds are segregated from operating disbursements and held in a non-interest-bearing USD demand deposit; no conversion or surrender calculation is required because the USD is the domestic legal tender. Correspondent clearing in the United States is via Fedwire or CHIPS, and the bank will verify the OFAC/beneficiary-screen result before final credit.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails are calibrated to the operating waterfall. For direct beechwood supplier payments: SWIFT MT103 via the RMI bank's U.S. correspondent, with invoice reference and commodity code 4407/4420. For purchase orders above US$50,000: Commercial Letter of Credit under UCP 600 issued by Bank of the Marshall Islands, payable against presentation of the bill of lading, packing list, certificate of origin, and conformity certificate. For U.S. e-commerce retail settlement: Amazon Pay and Stripe payout rails settle USD directly to a Stripe Treasury/Wise embedded account, which is then swept via ACH or SWIFT to the domestic operating DDA. No local clearing-house involvement is required; all trade payments are executed in USD, avoiding any need for cross-border FX conversion on the sales leg.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards (USD/EUR, USD/GBP) executed with a licensed RMI bank or its U.S. correspondent to hedge European beechwood procurement costs

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for settlement currencies lacking offshore deliverability, permitted for invoice currencies outside the major deliverable set but not required for the USD-denominated sales leg
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR) documented under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement when annual beechwood supply exposure exceeds US$250,000
Time-option and flexible forwards aligned to Amazon Pay weekly settlement cycles, executed under the bank's standard treasury master agreement without the need for a domestic central-bank filing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Report (Business Corporations Act 1990, §71) — annual return stating corporate name, registered office, resident agent, directors, officers, and authorized share structure; combined with payment of the annual government fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, General Registry Division, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands (filed through the licensed resident registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of the date of filing of the original Articles of Incorporation; no uniform calendar-year due date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: USD 100 statutory late penalty imposed immediately after the anniversary deadline; continued delinquency for 12 consecutive months authorizes the Registrar to administratively strike off the corporation and reserve its name

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation — verified UBO profile and shareholder transfer notification lodged with the registered agent's Beneficial Ownership Register (BOR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed resident registered agent (BOR custodian); no direct government filing in a non-inquiry year, but producible to the Registrar upon official demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at each incorporation anniversary and additionally within 30 days of any transfer, issuance, or redemption that changes a 10%+ beneficial ownership interest
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-response to the agent's annual UBO reminder permits the agent to resign; agent resignation without replacement triggers involuntary administrative strike-off by the Registrar

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory independent audit, financial statement filing, or public disclosure is required for a non-resident, tax-exempt Business Corporation under the BCA; audit obligations exist only for securities-listed issuers or where a creditor, investor, or payment-acquirer covenant imposes review
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as the general reference framework with US GAAP equally acceptable; statutory books must accurately reflect assets, liabilities, income, and expenditures in a clear and complete manner (BCA §74)

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: All natural persons holding 10% or more of the share capital must be identified to the licensed resident agent at each share transfer and reconfirmed annually at the incorporation anniversary; silent shelf structures disclosing nominee arrangements must provide the underlying natural-person owner to the agent for BOR recording, and the agent must transmit the BOR only upon formal written request by the Registrar
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book and Corporate Resolutions Record

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 750 – 1,500 per year (licensed registered agent and registered office retainer, excluding disbursements)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 (not statutorily required); USD 2,000 – 4,500 if a voluntary certified audit is procured for Amazon Pay/Stripe acquirer or distributor due diligence

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-resident Business Corporations deriving no Marshall Islands-source income are fully exempt from income tax; no capital gains tax, no value-added tax, no payroll tax on offshore employees, and no branch profits tax. The only recurrent cost is the annual corporate registry franchise fee (US$250 flat for non-resident BCs). A 3% gross revenue tax applies solely to RMI-source gross receipts from business activities conducted within the Republic.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Annual Corporate Report (Form AC-1) and, when RMI-source income is derived, Marshal Islands Income Tax Return (Form RMI-T1). Filed through the RMI Registrar of Corporations electronic filing portal and, for tax returns, through the RMI Ministry of Finance – Tax and Revenue Administration online system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual Corporate Report: due on the anniversary of incorporation. Income Tax Return: due by the last day of the fourth month following the end of the tax year (31 December for calendar-year filers), unless an extension of one month is granted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Indicate the foreign jurisdiction in which central management and control is exercised and confirm that no commercial activity is conducted within the Republic.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the foreign jurisdiction, e.g., 'British Virgin Islands – administrative and board functions conducted there'. Leave no blank; if the company is managed from a non-RMI location, this field is mandatory for the tax exemption claim.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form AC-1, Item 7 – RMI Source Revenue
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declare gross revenue derived from Marshall Islands sources.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter '0' for wholly offshore sales of Montessori wooden blocks. If any but-for RMI sales exist, report the exact gross amount; do not use 'N/A'.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certify that the corporation qualifies as an exempt non-resident domestic entity under Section 8 of the Income Tax Act 1989.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Check the certification box and sign as authorized officer. False certification triggers a US$5,000 administrative penalty and potential criminal sanctions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Form RMI-T1, Schedule B – Income Allocation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List gross income by source category: RMI-source vs. foreign-source.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident exempt companies will rarely file RMI-T1. If filed, attach a separate schedule detailing the source attribution; sales to unrelated offshore buyers should be classified as foreign-source.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the Annual Corporate Report: US$200 fixed penalty plus US$50 per month of delinquency. Late income tax return: 5% of unpaid tax per month up to 25%; a false exemption declaration: US$5,000 civil penalty; continued non-compliance may result in administrative dissolution or suspension from the corporate registry.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Republic of the Marshall Islands has enacted no comprehensive double taxation agreements as of the date of filing. Therefore, dividend distributions to foreign shareholders are not subject to any withholding tax, and no tax residence certificate or Form 6166 is needed to invoke treaty relief. If a future treaty enters force, the standard protocol is: (a) obtain a fiscal residency certificate from the foreign shareholder's tax authority; (b) submit a completed RMI Form W-TR to the Revenue and Tax Administration before remittance; and (c) maintain supporting ledger entries showing the beneficial ownership of the payee. Until that future date, all distributions are remitted net of zero RMI tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT: 0% for royalties and 0% for interest paid to non-residents. Treaty rates: N/A due to no tax treaties. Royalties and interest derived from intangible property of the Montessori toy brand and intercompany loans are untaxed at RMI-source provided the payer and payee are non-resident entities and the payment does not constitute income effectively connected with a RMI trade or business.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: US Dollar (USD). Domestic law does not prescribe a standard threshold; prudent compliance standard is to prepare a Local File when controlled transactions exceed US$1,000,000 per annum and a Master File when group consolidated revenue exceeds US$100,000,000. A Country-by-Country report is required only if the ultimate parent in a multinational group files CbC-Relevant reports and the RMI entity is a constituent entity.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: RMI Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) apply to entities carrying on 'relevant activities' (banking, insurance, fund management, financing, leasing, headquarters, distribution and service centers, shipping, and IP holding). Manufacturing of Montessori wooden blocks is not a designated relevant activity. However, the entity must maintain adequate substance with respect to its commercial functions: a registered agent in RMI, a dedicated business address, proper bookkeeping, and at least one director who exercises independent discretion. If the entity claims to be non-resident, it must be central managed and controlled outside the RMI; otherwise, the full RMI domestic tax system and ESR may apply, negating the tax exemption.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining effective management and control in the Marshall Islands while declaring non-residence to avoid the 3% gross revenue tax, or fabricating a foreign seat of management in an annual report.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil penalty of up to US$10,000, disgorgement of all taxes saved, 15% interest on unreported tax; criminal conviction carries a fine of US$25,000 and imprisonment for a term not exceeding 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers are jointly and severally liable for unpaid taxes and penalties; the court may impose travel bans and restitution orders against personal assets, and in case of willful fraud, imprisonment of directors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Business Corporation as a pass-through shell to hide beneficial ownership of the wooden-block trademarks, sales contracts, or bank accounts, with no commercial substance in any jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Dissolution of the entity; revocation of the certificate of incorporation; US$50,000 administrative penalty under the Business Corporation Act; forfeiture of assets linked to the shell arrangement.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A court may pierce the corporate veil, rendering directors personally liable for all corporate debts; they may be disqualified from acting as directors for 10 years. Repeated use for money laundering triggers the RMI Proceeds of Crime Act, leading to seizure of personal property.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to register accurate beneficial ownership information with the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit, or failing to conduct customer due diligence when opening merchant accounts (e.g., Amazon Pay, Stripe) used for sales of toys.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: US$25,000 fine per violation; restitution of funds; deregistration of the company. Escalated penalties apply if the deficiency is used to conceal a funded terrorism-linked transaction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Director liability is strict: personal fines up to US$100,000 and imprisonment up to 3 years for knowingly filing false ownership declarations or obstructing an AML inspection.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Underpricing export sales of the wooden blocks to a related distributor in a low-tax jurisdiction without any economic analysis, intending to shift profit away from the manufacturing entity's actual value-driving operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: If RMI source income is understated, the Revenue Administration assesses a 3% gross revenue tax on the deemed RMI-source portion, plus a 20% accuracy-related penalty and late payment interest at 1.5% per month.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly approve or create false transfer pricing documentation face personal civil penalties up to US$20,000 and exclusion from serving on RMI-registered boards. Criminal referral for fraudulent misrepresentation could result in up to 2 years of imprisonment.
